content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AMU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AMU Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post in Economics at the AMU Malappuram Centre.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in the concerned subject or an equivalent qualification, along with NET/SLET/SET clearance or an exemption.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of Rs. 500/- is applicable for all categories of candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official AMU careers portal before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve the scrutiny of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the AMU Malappuram Centre located?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post at the AMU Malappuram Centre.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with a Ph.D. from a foreign university apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates awarded a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 in World University Rankings are eligible.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the Important Links section of this article.
